notes.subject: ayɛ
notes.rationale: Hebrew marks the address only by context; Bamanankan vocative particle supplied and bracketed

notes.subject: barika
notes.rationale: אשרי is an interjection 'how happy!'; rendered with the blessing-word barika, the closest Bamanankan exclamative

notes.subject: אשרי
notes.rationale: plural-construct form used as interjection; the beatitude formula opens and closes the psalm's frame with verse 5

translation: Yawe Tsevaot, ⟨ayɛ⟩, hadamaden min bɛ i kunbɛn, o barika!
